headword: {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}
gloss: limited express train; special express train

definitions.gloss: limited express train; special express train
definitions.explanation: A high-speed train service that stops at only a few major stations, offering faster travel than regular express trains. A surcharge is usually required in addition to the base fare.

examples.japanese: {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}で{大阪|おおさか}に{向|む}かう。
examples.english: To head to Osaka by limited express train.

examples.japanese: {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}に{乗|の}るには{特急券|とっきゅうけん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need a limited express ticket to ride the limited express train.

examples.japanese: {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}だと{三時間|さんじかん}かかるが、{特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}なら{一時間半|いちじかんはん}で{着|つ}く。
examples.english: It takes three hours by local train, but you can get there in an hour and a half by limited express.

notes:
A compound of {特急|とっきゅう} (limited express; abbreviation of {特別急行|とくべつきゅうこう}) and {列車|れっしゃ} (train). In the Japanese railway hierarchy, {特急|とっきゅう} is faster than {急行|きゅうこう} (express) and {快速|かいそく} (rapid), stopping at fewer stations. Most private railways and JR lines operate {特急|とっきゅう} services with reserved seating and a supplemental fare ({特急料金|とっきゅうりょうきん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}に{乗|の}る: to ride a limited express
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}の{指定席|していせき}: reserved seat on a limited express
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}の{時刻表|じこくひょう}: limited express timetable
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}が{遅|おく}れる: the limited express is delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}: express train — stops at more stations than a limited express; slower
- {新幹線|しんかんせん}: bullet train — the fastest category, running on dedicated high-speed tracks
- {快速|かいそく}: rapid train — faster than local but slower than express; usually no surcharge
